dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になれば始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for joining me today. We'll get started now that it's time.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 最初に、年齢と性別をおしえていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 18 女です。
dialogue.English: I'm 18, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 気持ちがあがらないんです
dialogue.English: I can't seem to lift my spirits.

dialogue.content: ぜんぶ面倒くさくて
dialogue.English: Everything just feels like a hassle.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。どんな時にそう感じることが多いですか。
dialogue.English: I see. When do you most often feel that way?

dialogue.content: 最近は常に思います
dialogue.English: Lately, I feel that way all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今は学生でいらっしゃいますか。
dialogue.English: I understand. Are you currently a student?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学年をうかがえますか。
dialogue.English: May I ask what grade you're in?

dialogue.content: 高校3年です
dialogue.English: I'm a senior in high school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。学校はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. How is school?

dialogue.content: 普通です
dialogue.English: It's fine.

dialogue.content: 通学には支障は出ていないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you having any trouble attending school?

dialogue.content: はい、普通に通ってます
dialogue.English: No, I'm attending normally.

dialogue.content: お友達とはどのような感じですか？
dialogue.English: How are things with your friends?

dialogue.content: 普通に仲良く話してます
dialogue.English: We talk and get along just fine.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。お友達とお話している時は、面倒くさいというような感じはないのですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. So when you're talking with your friends, you don't feel that sense of everything being a hassle?

dialogue.content: はい、面倒くさいとかはないけど…気持ちはたのしくはなくて
dialogue.English: Right, it's not that it feels like a hassle or anything... but I don't feel any enjoyment.

dialogue.content: 何も楽しく感じないんです
dialogue.English: I can't find joy in anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そのような気持ちになってきたのはいつごろからでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. About when did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 正確には思い出せないんですが、多分昨年の初めくらいから徐々になりました
dialogue.English: I can't remember exactly, but I think it gradually started around the beginning of last year.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。コロナの影響でとても学生生活にもいろいろ変化はあったと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I imagine the COVID-19 pandemic brought about many changes to your student life.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何か気持ちの変化に影響していることで、心当たりのあるできごととかはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular event that comes to mind that might have affected this change in your feelings?

dialogue.content: わかりません…
dialogue.English: I'm not sure...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。学校の授業とかはコロナなどで変化はありましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Have your school classes changed due to COVID?

dialogue.content: オンラインばかりです
dialogue.English: They've been mostly online.

dialogue.content: 段々と再開されてきましたが
dialogue.English: They have gradually restarted in person, though.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お友達ともなかなか会えない日々でお辛いですよね？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult not being able to see your friends very often, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 友達とはすこしだけど、会ったりしてました
dialogue.English: I did see my friends a little.

dialogue.content: でも、気軽には会えなくて、
dialogue.English: But we couldn't just meet up casually,

dialogue.content: 些細な話とか出来なかったのはあります
dialogue.English: and we weren't able to have those small, everyday conversations.

dialogue.content: あと、受験勉強もずっとひとりでやらなきゃならなくて
dialogue.English: Also, I've had to do all my studying for entrance exams by myself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。つらいですとね。孤独感を感じられても無理もないと思います。お友達に、今の気持ちが上がらない状態のことは相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. That must be tough. It's completely understandable that you would feel a sense of loneliness. Have you talked to your friends about how you've been feeling down?

dialogue.content: はい、最近そういう人多くて
dialogue.English: Yes, there are a lot of people feeling that way lately.

dialogue.content: そうなんでうすね。受験勉強ということですが、今後の進路についてお聞きしてもよいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned studying for exams; may I ask about your plans for after graduation?

dialogue.content: 大学を受けています
dialogue.English: I'm applying to universities.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。とても大変な時期ですよね。何か大学で期待していることとかはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a very demanding time. Is there anything you're looking forward to about university?

dialogue.content: 特にはないです
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 多分ずっとまた勉強だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it will probably just be more studying.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。何か学びたいこととか、具体的にあったり、将来の夢とか、小さなことでもあればおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there anything specific you want to study, or any dreams for the future—even small ones—that you could share?

dialogue.content: 特にはないですとりあえず受かったとこの中で偏差値が高い大学にいきます
dialogue.English: Not really. For now, I'll just go to the highest-ranked university out of the ones I get accepted to.

dialogue.content: そうでうね。受験真っ只中ですもんね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You're right in the middle of exam season.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は受験でとてもきつい感じに思うことも多いかもしれませんね。受験に向けて一人で頑張ってこられたこと、コロナであまり学校に行けてなかったこと、いろいろ気持ちが上がらない要因があったと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You're probably feeling that things are very tough right now because of the exams. You've had to work so hard for them on your own, and you haven't been able to go to school much because of COVID—it seems there are many factors that could be contributing to you feeling down. What do you think?

dialogue.content: それもあるかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be part of it.

dialogue.content: 受験が終わればなおりますか？
dialogue.English: Will I feel better once the exams are over?

dialogue.content: そうですね。受験はとても大きな節目でもあり、終われば生活も大きく変わるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's a good question. The exams are a huge milestone, and once they're over, your life will probably change quite a bit, don't you think?

dialogue.content: 大学になると、どんな風に変わりますか？
dialogue.English: How do things change when you get to university?

dialogue.content: 受験勉強ばかりで、いまいちイメージできないんです。勉強は引き続きあるから、何か変わるのかな、って…
dialogue.English: I've been so focused on exam prep that I can't really picture it. Since there will still be studying, I wonder if anything will really change...

dialogue.content: 環境が変われば、お友達も変わり、コロナも落ち着いていけば、学校生活も高校とはかなり違ってくるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When your environment changes, you'll make new friends, and as the COVID situation calms down, university life might be quite different from high school, don't you think?

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: これからのことは、やはり不安も大きいですよね？
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel a lot of uncertainty about the future, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 不安というより、イメージがつかない感じで
dialogue.English: It's less anxiety and more that I just can't picture it.

dialogue.content: ずっと今のような感じが続く気がしています
dialogue.English: I feel like things will just keep being the way they are now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 長いコロナの影響でそのように感じられるのも無理もないと思います。
dialogue.English: It's understandable to feel that way, given the prolonged impact of the pandemic.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達と進学後の話とかはされましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked with your friends about what you'll do after graduation?

dialogue.content: はい、たまにします
dialogue.English: Yes, sometimes.

dialogue.content: でも、今みんなもそれどころじゃないので
dialogue.English: But right now, everyone is too preoccupied,

dialogue.content: どちらというと、試験の話とかばかりです
dialogue.English: so if anything, we mostly just talk about exams.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今はお気持ちが上がらない中とてもお辛いとは思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be very difficult for you, feeling so down at a time like this.

dialogue.content: はい、たのしめないから、どんどん気持ちがさがります
dialogue.English: Yes, since I can't enjoy anything, my mood just keeps getting lower.

dialogue.content: ご家族との関係はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How is your relationship with your family?

dialogue.content: 普通です。父は海外なので、母と弟と暮らしてます
dialogue.English: It's normal. My dad's overseas, so I live with my mom and my younger brother.

dialogue.content: 喧嘩もするけど、割とはなします
dialogue.English: We argue sometimes, but we talk a fair amount.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母さまとは受験のことや、今のお気持ちのこととかは伝えられていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you been able to tell your mother about the exams or how you're feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 話します。でも、勉強のこと言われるとムカつくので最近は詳しくは話してません
dialogue.English: I do. But when she brings up my studying, it irritates me, so I haven't been sharing the details lately.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お父様は海外ですと、連絡は難しい感じでしょうか？弟さんとはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Since your father is overseas, is it difficult to stay in touch? And how are things with your brother?

dialogue.content: 父は週一でSkypeで話してます。弟とは、普通ですかね。
dialogue.English: I talk to my dad on Skype once a week. With my brother, things are normal, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。週に１回でもお話できれば、お父様もうれしいと思いますよ。ちなみにどんなお話されているかお聞きしても良いですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sure your father is happy to be able to talk with you, even if it's just once a week. May I ask what you usually talk about?

dialogue.content: 母が土曜の夜にSkypeするんで、そのついでってかんじで話は他愛ない事です。
dialogue.English: My mom Skypes with him on Saturday nights, so I just join in. We just make small talk.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お父様はしばらく海外ですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Will your father be overseas for a while longer?

dialogue.content: もう、5年くらい海外にいます。コロナだから本帰国が未定らしく
dialogue.English: He's been overseas for about five years now. Because of COVID, they say his permanent return to Japan is undecided.

dialogue.content: ずっと海外でもいいんですけど
dialogue.English: Though I wouldn't mind if he stayed overseas forever.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。でも、少しの時間でも、他愛ないお話であっても、週に一度でもお話されていて、ご家族ともコミュニケーションがとれているように感じますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. But even if it's for a short time and just small talk, the fact that you're speaking once a week sounds like you're communicating well with your family. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そうですかね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: すいません、母がお風呂に入れってうるさいので、今日はこのあたりで大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Sorry, my mom is nagging me to take a bath, so I think I'll end it here for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。また、気軽に相談ください。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Please feel free to reach out again anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 最後に何かございませんか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else before we finish?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: No, I'm fine.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。それでは終了させていただきます。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. We'll end the session here. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 失礼します。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
